name: Collection Promo Tile
summary: Passive editorial article for one optional canonical Link destination inside a Collection Grid item, with contextual media alternatives and parent-owned one- or two-track placement.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Passive self-contained editorial article; it is never a synthetic clickable container.

anatomy.name: media
anatomy.description: Target-supplied native image with contextual informative or decorative alternative text.

anatomy.name: overlay
anatomy.description: Passive contrast layer rendered only with media.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Required visible article heading; the owning target chooses a valid contextual heading rank.

anatomy.name: cta
anatomy.description: One canonical native Link rendered only from a complete visible-label and href pair.

anatomy.name: ctaIcon
anatomy.description: Passive target-supplied directional indicator; not a public icon property.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Occupies one compatible Collection Grid track.

variants.name: span-2
variants.description: Requests two parent Collection Grid tracks when the named container has at least two; otherwise remains one track.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One intrinsic size with private container-responsive internal geometry.

states.name: default
states.description: Statement surface and primary text without media.

states.name: withMedia
states.description: Native media, passive theme-opposed bounded overlay and inverse content.

states.name: span2
states.description: Parent list item spans two available Collection Grid tracks without source reordering.

states.name: ctaHover
states.description: Canonical Link hover with contextual inherited color and stronger underline.

states.name: ctaFocus
states.description: Canonical Link keyboard focus with contextual current/system color.

behavior.name: articleSemantics
behavior.description: The root is a passive article with one required visible heading; targets select a heading level appropriate to the containing document.

behavior.name: promotionLink
behavior.description: At most one canonical native Link navigates to the promoted resource. The root has no role, tabindex, href, click delegation, or keyboard handler.

behavior.name: ctaPair
behavior.description: CTA label and href form a required pair. Missing either value omits the complete CTA and never invents a destination.

behavior.name: mediaAlternative
behavior.description: Use concise informative alt when media adds meaning and empty alt when it is decorative or redundant with adjacent copy; never derive alt automatically from title.

behavior.name: mediaContrast
behavior.description: The passive bounded overlay is rendered only with media and keeps visible content contrast measurable across the crop.

behavior.name: collectionPlacement
behavior.description: Collection Grid owns list membership, source order and grid placement. Span 2 affects the parent list item only when at least two tracks are available.

behavior.name: firstPartyBoundary
behavior.description: Neutral v1 represents first-party editorial content only. Sponsored or paid placement, disclosure, targeting, frequency and measurement are outside E6.

behavior.name: resultTruth
behavior.description: The target owns eligible pages and insertion. Promo placement never changes product query, order, pagination, counts or filter/sort truth; incompatible targets omit E6.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Logical properties, zero-min content, wrapping and private inline-size container modes preserve localized, RTL, narrow and zoomed content without clipping.

behavior.name: motionAndRuntime
behavior.description: Canonical Link removes decorative transition under reduced motion. E6 adds no listener, observer, timer, request, storage, delegated link area, or neutral runtime.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: One-track Default or accepted two-track request inside a compatible Collection Grid parent.

properties.name: media
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit media and overlay and use the statement surface with primary text.
properties.description: Optional target-supplied native media. Responsive source, crop, focal point, loading and decoding policy remain target-owned.

properties.name: mediaAlt
properties.unsetBehavior: Use empty alt only when target content policy classifies the media as decorative or redundant.
properties.description: Contextual native image alternative; concise text when informative and intentionally empty when decorative or redundant.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Required non-empty visible article heading; invalid missing title omits the complete tile.

properties.name: ctaLabel
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the CTA unless href is also non-empty.
properties.description: Visible descriptive canonical Link label; requires a non-empty href.

properties.name: href
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the CTA unless ctaLabel is also non-empty.
properties.description: Native promotion destination; requires a non-empty visible ctaLabel and is never invented by an adapter.

accessibility: Render the root as a passive article with one non-empty visible heading and a target-contextual heading rank.
Use at most one native canonical Link with descriptive visible text and a real href; do not make the root synthetically clickable.
Treat ctaLabel and href as a required pair and omit an incomplete CTA without inventing values.
Use concise alt text when media adds meaning and empty alt when it is decorative or redundant with adjacent copy.
Keep the overlay and directional icon passive and absent when their owning media or CTA is absent.
Measure normal and large text contrast against the composited media crop and no-media statement surface.
Preserve source order, parent list semantics, visible focus, native Enter activation, text wrapping, RTL and forced-color behavior.
Honor reduced-motion preferences through canonical Link and add no E6-specific animation or runtime.

web.notes: Native article/image/anchor composition with canonical Collection Grid and Link classes; zero E6-specific runtime.

shopify.notes: E6-A requires an explicit collection-grid block or record whose owning section preserves product order, pagination and counts and supplies schema, localization, data mapping, editor preview and live-store evidence.
